headline: Fronts Surge as Bases Trade Hands Across War
war_summary: Since the 12:10 edition the war has sharpened on a half‑dozen sectors. Godcrofts has erupted with twenty ownership changes in the last two hours and seventy‑two in the past day, while casualties remain moderate. Fishermans Row continues its relentless churn, logging thirty‑nine flips in twenty‑four hours and heavy losses on both sides. Weathered Expanse, still the bloodiest theatre, added no new flips in the last two hours and only seven in six, its two‑hour casualty rate easing to roughly four‑hundred Colonial and seven‑hundred Warden per window. Stlican Shelf recorded three fresh flips in two hours and twenty‑eight in the day, with casualties climbing sharply. Farranac Coast, previously quiet, now shows five flips in two hours and eight in twenty‑four, accompanied by rising attrition. Linn Mercy posted seventeen flips in the last day, though only three in the past six hours. Callahan’s Passage, Mooring County and Viper Pit each saw only modest activity, while all other sectors reported no ownership changes.
